messages:
sam: FYI pushed a small tag change on the NAT GW routing policy in us-west-2, seeing ~30% of new GPU nodes stuck in provisioning (Init). Anyone else?

liz: Seeing it, warming pools not draining. ETA?

natalie: Logs show KMS decrypt 403 on provisioning agent when it hits privatelink. Might be the role tag mismatch. Repro steps:
```
aws ec2 describe-tags --filters "Name=resource-id,Values=nat-xxxx" --region us-west-2
kubectl -n infra logs provisioner-abc | grep "403"
```

raj: Confirmed. provisioner logs: "AccessDenied: KMS:Decrypt" for /var/run/keystore socket. Also 172.31.0.0/16 egress blocked by new fw-rule.

kevin: Cost note: GPU warm pool shortfall -> auto-scale triggered more on-demand in other region, extra ~$2.5k last hour. We should rollback if fix will take >30m :grimacing:

sam: ops-bot triggered rollout rollback? @ops-bot

ops-bot: alert: rollback not initiated — requires +1 from infra lead. See #incidents if needed. :warning:

liz: Quick fix — reapply tag "env:privnet" to natgw and add egress CIDR exception for keystore IP range.

natalie: Policy we're seeing mismatch on:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
     "Effect": "Allow",
     "Action": ["kms:Decrypt"],
     "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd"
  }]
}
```
Make sure the condition on "aws:ResourceTag/env" is not present or matches.

raj: I'll patch the FW rule and re-run e2e. If green, we can update orchestration to avoid hard dependency on that tag.

kevin: Also want a follow-up to add alerting on provisioning success rate and a billing runbook for cross-region failover cost.

sam: Plan: raj patches FW (10m), natalie verifies KMS decrypt (5m), liz triggers warm-pool drain (5m), rollback if still failing. Ping me w/ ✅ or logs.

liz: patch applied, NAT tag restored, egress rule widened. warm-pool drain started.

natalie: KMS decrypt success now. provisioner logs show node init progressing.

raj: E2E green. GPUs back to healthy. cost bump stopped.

kevin: Saved approx $1.8k vs full rollback. We'll open a infra follow-up ticket for tagging drift detection.

sam: filing follow-up: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-1829

liz: nice work team :tada:
